title: Element
description: Something the agent can interact with inside a State. Elements are embedded in a State (not first-class graph nodes) because the same semantic element reappears across many states; their ids stay globally unique so transitions and assertions can point at them.

role.description: ARIA role as observed, e.g. textbox, button, link, checkbox, combobox, dialog.

name.description: Accessible name as observed (label text, aria-label, button caption).

semantic.description: What the element MEANS. This is the stable identity; role/name/locator are observations that may change.

purpose.description: Stable snake_case purpose, e.g. coupon_code, email, submit_order, cart_item_count.

data_subject.description: Application data this element reads or writes, e.g. order.discount, user.email.

vocabulary.description: Namespace for `purpose`, when the same purpose name means different things in different domains.

locator.description: Playwright-friendly locator. Evidence for driving the browser, never the semantic identity.

oneOf.description: Ordered fallback list: try each locator until one resolves.

actions.description: Interactions this element supports. `read` means the agent can only observe it.

value_domain.description: What kind of value the element accepts/shows. Used to generate test data and to spot invalid-input cases.

current_value.description: Value observed in the evidence observations for this state, when it is part of the state's identity.

presence.description: conditional: only rendered under some conditions. optional: may or may not be present.

visible_when.description: Human-readable condition under which the element appears, when presence is conditional.

region.description: Page region the element lives in: header, nav, main, cart_summary, modal, footer.

within.description: Parent container element, for nested structures such as list rows.

value.description: Selector payload. For strategy=role this is the role name; for testid/css this is the raw selector body.

name.description: Accessible name filter, used together with strategy=role.

exact.description: Match text/name exactly. Playwright defaults to substring matching.

level.description: Heading level, for strategy=role with role=heading.

frame.description: Frame or iframe path, when the element is not in the main frame.
